partition.description: AWS partition every ARN is built from: aws or aws-us-gov.

validation.error_message: partition must be aws or aws-us-gov.

region.description: Region the monitoring resources live in, e.g. us-east-1 or us-gov-west-1.

account_id.description: Account that owns the log groups and the key.

name_prefix.description: Prefix for log group, alarm and topic names.

app_log_retention_days.description: Retention of the service log groups; the audit mirror always keeps 400 days.

protected_role_names.description: IAM roles (operators, CI deployer, task roles) that must never delete the audit mirror or its key.
